description: Canned GitHub facts. The fake GitHub client serves these; nothing is fetched. A case may override any of it via steps[].fake.github.
_note: Three repositories chosen to exercise the four project-reach weight cases in ADR-0007 §7 — a published library with everything, an application with neither dependents nor downloads, and a small library with no dependents.

acme/bigrepo._case: Case 1 — all five metrics present. A published library.

acme/platform._case: Case 4 — application. No dependents, no downloads. contributors weighted up to 0.35.

indie/smalllib._case: Case 3 — published, nothing depends on it yet. Deliberately small: proves the log/percentile blend does not collapse it to zero against a 190k-star maximum.

private/hidden._case: Not public. Evidence referencing it must fail validation with not_public.

acme/bigrepo#101._note: Alice's strongest evidence. Substantial, complex, well-reviewed.
